in_hindi.name: दिल्ली
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Dilli' is believed to be derived from 'Dil', the heart, and 'Dur', the fort. It is also called 'Dil Ki Dilli', meaning the heart of the heart or the soul of the city. The name 'Dilli' is also associated with the Hindu god Rama, as the city was believed to be the site of his kingdom.

in_marathi.name: Dilli
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dilli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dilli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Dhil', which means 'heart'. The name Dilli is often associated with the city of Delhi, which was once known as the 'Heart of Hindustan'. It symbolizes strength, power, and fortitude.
